The {{Color BotW|Blue|clothing shop}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|materials shop}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|general shop}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|inn}} should be able to provide everything you need. Oh, and just between you and me, there's also a {{Color BotW|Red|shrine}} in the hills of this village. They say up and behind those hills resides Kakariko's {{Color BotW|Blue|guardian spirit}}. I hear she's incredibly beautiful. I'm too intimidated to go see for myself, though... It's said that she offers a special blessing to those that visit her... You should go there and see for yourself.|Dorian|BotW}}{{Cite|What to do? At this rate, Grandmother's health isn't going to... Ugh. And Claree's so busy running the {{Color TotK|Red|clothing shop}}... I'll just have to do it myself. I'll find a {{Color TotK|Red|cure}} for my grandmother.|Lasli|TotK}} is a recurring location in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Features and Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Enchanted is an [[Armor Shop]] located in [[Kakariko Village]]. It is run by [[Claree]] who stands behind the counter, offering her curated "Claree Collection";{{Cite|We exclusively stock the special garments of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Claree Collection}}!|Claree|BotW}} the [[Hylian Armor Series]] and [[Stealth Set]]. The ''[[Rumor Mill: Volume 1]]'' can be found on the counter nearby. During the day, Claree's sister [[Lasli]] stands outside of Enchanted, where she advertises the Shop to people traveling through Kakariko Village.{{Cite|We're open rain or shine! {{Color BotW|Blue|Enchanted}}, right this way!|Lasli|BotW}} When [[Link]] enters Enchanted, Claree will inquire if he needs new clothing.{{Cite|Need some new clothes?|Claree|BotW}} The first time Link approaches any of the Stealth Set, she will reveal that the [[Armor Set]] is exclusive to Enchanted.{{Cite|Isn't that lovely? It's a limited-edition Enchanted exclusive!|Claree|BotW}} She also notifies Link of the clothing's ability to improve [[Stealth]], but she warns that it has lower [[Defense]] as a trade-off.{{Cite|While you wear it, your footsteps are nearly soundless, so it's perfect for hunting and stuff.|Claree|BotW}}{{Cite|Oh, but it offers very little defense. Small price for the extra stealth...|Claree|BotW}} Should Link make a purchase, Claree will thank him for doing so.{{Cite|Thanks! Take good care of it!|Claree|BotW}} She tells Link that he made a good choice if he purchased a piece of the Stealth Set,{{Cite|Thanks! You've made a great purchase! Really!|Claree|BotW}} and she claims that pieces of the Hylian Armor Series will look good on him.{{Cite|Thanks! That'll look great on you! Really!|Claree|BotW}} As part of the "[[Flown the Coop]]" [[Side Quest]], one of [[Cado]]'s [[Cucco]]s can be found on the roof of Enchanted. In order to complete the Quest, Link must remove it from the roof and return it to the Cucco Coop.{{Cite|Cado's beloved Cuccos made it over the fence and escaped.

Before the breakout, Cado had {{Color BotW|Red|10 Cuccos}} in total. Find all of them, and return them to their enclosure.|Adventure Log|BotW}} ====Creatures==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |BotW= Cucco }} ====Wares and Pricing==== {{Wares|game= BotW |- | Hylian Hood | 60 | A hood woven using traditional Hyrulean methods. It's made from a sturdy material to protect travelers from the harsh sun and weather. |- | Hylian Tunic | 120 | A common garb that achieved widespread popularity in Hyrule, particularly among travelers. Its light-yet-sturdy fabric doesn't limit movement. |- | Hylian Trousers | 90 | Traditional dress trousers of Hyrule. The plush fabric makes these trousers quite comfortable, and their high durability makes them ideal for travelers. |- | Stealth Mask | 500 | It may look like a regular cloth mask, but it was made using Sheikah crafting techniques to suppress the noisy rustling of clothes. Perfect for sneaking about. |- | Stealth Chest Guard | 700 | Armor designed for stealth, passed down through the Sheikah tribe. The special fabrics suppress the rustling of clothes even when moving quickly. |- | Stealth Tights | 600 | Members of the Sheikah tribe wear these tights when they need to move stealthily. They're made from noise-suppressing cloth, a hallmark of ancient Sheikah technology. }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Quests| {{TotK Quest |name= Gloom-Borne Illness |type= Side Quest |giver= [[Lasli]] |location= [[Kakariko Village]] }} }} When [[Link]] first arrives, Enchanted is operated solely by [[Claree]]. Claree's sister, [[Lasli]], is unable to help run the [[Armor Shop]] because their grandmother, [[Nanna]], fell ill after coming into contact with [[Gloom]].{{Cite|... Huh? Oh, uh... Welcome. Sorry. I must have drifted off. I'm just so tired lately. *sigh* Look, I know it won't help to talk about it, but I'm gonna do it anyway. My grandmother's really sick. I'm running the shop while my little sister, {{Color TotK|Red|Lasli}}, is looking after her. We're sort of getting by... But we're both so exhausted.|Claree|TotK}} In order to pay for her grandmother's treatment, Claree raises the price of every piece of [[Armor]] to 5,000 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|I'm sorry about this, but we really need money for Grandmother's treatment. I've had to {{Color TotK|Red|hike up the prices}} on everything we have in stock. It's just for now though. As soon as Grandmother is healthy again, I can {{Color TotK|Red|set our prices back to normal}}.|Claree|TotK}} When spoken to, she promises to lower the prices once her grandmother's health has returned to normal and apologizes for bringing her family situation into her work.{{Cite|Ugh, I know I shouldn't bring my {{Color TotK|Red|home situation}} into the shop with me... {{Small|{{Color TotK|Gray|It's nice to get it off my chest, but I probably shouldn't have dumped all that on a customer... OK, time to salvage my professionalism.}}}} I'm so sorry about that. Allow me to welcome you to Enchanted!|Claree|TotK}} Claree warns that Enchanted does not carry fashion items popularized by [[Cece]] in [[Hateno Village]], but affirms that their clothing provides both style and quality.{{Cite|Anyway... You can't get your hands on Cece-brand fashion unless you go southeast to {{Color TotK|Red|Hateno Village}}. But why go there when you can meet all your fashion needs right here? We serve both style AND quality!|Claree|TotK}} Lasli wishes to visit Hateno Village to study fashion herself, but is unable to due to Nanna's health.{{Cite|[Cece brand?] The Cece brand is a fashion phenomenon that's getting attention all over Hyrule. I can't believe such a hot brand came out of {{Color TotK|Red|Hateno Village}} in Necluda. I hope my sister can go there to study fashion, but... With our {{Color TotK|Red|situation at home}}... Well. Oh, sorry about that! Don't mind me.|Claree|TotK}}{{Cite|[Situation at home?] You see, my grandmother's sick in bed with a {{Color TotK|Red|strange illness}}, and my little sister, {{Color TotK|Red|Lasli}}, volunteered to take care of her. Lasli was supposed to be studying fashion out southeast in Hateno Village by now... But she loves our grandmother so much that she's put her dreams on hold.|Claree|TotK}} If Link buys any [[Item]]s while their prices are inflated, Claree will offer to repay him.{{Cite|You'll buy it?! I... Thank you. If Grandmother gets better soon, please let me {{Color TotK|Red|repay}} you.|Claree|TotK}} As a promotional campaign, Claree will give out [[Sheikah Fabric]] with any first purchase from the Shop at any point.{{Cite|When you buy a piece of clothing from us, we're offering a {{Color TotK|Red|special gift}}! So here you go, you fashion maven, you.|Claree|TotK}} After Link completes the "[[Gloom-Borne Illness]]" [[Side Quest]] and Nanna returns to good health, Claree lowers her prices as promised.{{Cite|Oh, it's you! Now that Grandmother's better, I can go back to our normal prices. The fashion world owes you a debt! Now, where was I? Ah, yes! We also buy anything you don't need, so just talk to me when you're ready! Ah, that reminds me! For a limited time, customers who buy a piece of clothing from us will receive... a {{Color TotK|Red|special gift}}! So get shopping!|Claree|TotK}} She will also reimburse Link for the difference between the normal and inflated prices for any purchases made while her grandmother was ill.{{Cite|Oh, right. That was you who bought the overpriced clothes at {{Color TotK|Red|Enchanted}}... Sorry about that. Let me refund you the difference between the markup and the proper price.|Claree|TotK}} When she recovers to full health, Nanna will stand outside the entrance and recommend Enchanted's wares to passers-by.{{Cite|If you're planning to travel, {{Color TotK|Red|Enchanted}} should be your first stop!|Nanna|TotK}} She will recommend either the [[Radiant Attire]] or the [[Stealth Attire]].{{Cite|The {{Color TotK|Red|radiant attire}} would suit you, I think.|Nanna|TotK}}{{Cite|The {{Color TotK|Red|stealth attire}} would suit you, I think.|Nanna|TotK}} If Link is already wearing either Armor Set, she will compliment him.{{Cite|Let me get a good look at that outfit. That's radiant attire, isn't it? My, my! It suits you! You'll be happy with your purchase, I'm sure of it!|Nanna|TotK}}{{Cite|Let me get a good look at that outfit... That's stealth attire, isn't it? My, my! It suits you! You'll be happy with your purchase, I'm sure of it!|Nanna|TotK}} After Link buys both Armor Sets, she will call him one of their best customers and remind him that Enchanted also buys Items.{{Cite|We sure appreciate your business! You're one of our very best customers. Remember, we're happy to buy if you're selling. So visit {{Color TotK|Red|Enchanted}} when you have business to do!|Nanna|TotK}} ====Wares and Pricing==== {{Wares|game= TotK|prices= Raised Prices, Normal Prices |- | Radiant Mask | 5,000 | 800 | A mask painted with dye made from crushed luminous stones. Its bone-like patterns give off a lurid, mysterious glow in the dark. |- | Radiant Shirt | 5,000 | 800 | The paint on this shirt is made from crushed luminous stones. It causes the shirt to show a glowing bone-like pattern in the dark. |- | Radiant Tights | 5,000 | 800 | The paint on these tights is made from crushed luminous stones. It causes the tights to show a glowing bone-like pattern in the dark. |- | Stealth Mask | 5,000 | 500 | It may look like a regular cloth mask, but it was made using Sheikah crafting techniques to suppress the noisy rustling of clothes. Perfect for sneaking about. |- | Stealth Chest Guard | 5,000 | 700 | Armor designed for stealth, passed down through the Sheikah tribe. The special fabrics suppress the rustling of clothes even when moving quickly. |- | Stealth Tights | 5,000 | 600 | Members of the Sheikah tribe wear these tights when they need to move stealthily. They're made from noise-suppressing cloth, a hallmark of ancient Sheikah technology. }} ==Trivia== * Enchanted contains several examples of [[Hylian (Language)|Hylian]] typography. ** The wooden sign above the door reads as "Tailor."{{Cite|{{Script|Hylian BotW|Tailor}}|N/A|BotW}} ** The mat in front of the door is meant to say "Welcome," but it has been mirrored to instead read as "emocleW."{{Cite|{{Script|Hylian BotW|emocleW}}|N/A|BotW}} ** The banners outside translate to "Get defensive" and "Protect yourself."{{Cite|{{Script|Hylian BotW|Get defensive}}|N/A|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Script|Hylian BotW|Protect yourself}}|N/A|BotW}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ===Other Names=== {{Other Names |- | Kakariko Village Armor Shop{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page= 412}} | {{TotK}} | {{Guide/TotK Piggyback}} | {{TotK}} }} ==Gallery== File:BotW Enchanted Interior.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The interior of Enchanted File:TotK Enchanted Interior.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The interior of Enchanted ==See Also== {{See Also| * Armor Shop * Claree * Kakariko Village * Lasli }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Armor Shops, Kakariko Village |locations= BotW }} [[de:Boutique „Zwei Früchtchen“]]
